⚛️ Launched on PQC Market

$QI wasn't launched the ordinary way. Quantum Inu launched on PQC Market, a launchpad that proves who created a token using post-quantum cryptography — so $QI's origin is attested with techniques built to survive the quantum era.

🔐 Hash-Based Signatures

WOTS / XMSS one-time signature identities secure the launch attestation — security from hash functions, not the math quantum computers break.

🌲 Merkle Trees

XMSS organizes thousands of one-time keys into a single Merkle tree root. One compact root, every launch verifiable against it.

🧾 SHA-256 Attestations

The launch record is hashed with SHA-256 and anchored via IPFS + SPL Memo — a permanent, public proof of $QI's launch that anyone can check.

🕹️Open Quantum Arcade

Play with the pack — QI games right in your browser. No downloads, no sign-ups.

🪐 QI Quantum Orbit

Ride the atom's orbit and let go at the perfect moment to sling it to the next planet. Chain planets to build speed, thread the golden bonus rings (+25) — just don't let go into deep space.

▶ Play Quantum Orbit

☄️ QI Quantum Asteroids

Pilot the Q-Bot's ship through the belt and blast the boulders apart — larges split into mediums, mediums into smalls (+20 / +50 / +100), and a golden atom is worth +250. Every wave brings more rocks, moving faster. Three ships — how deep can you get?

▶ Play Quantum Asteroids

🔨 QI Quantum Whack-a-Pup

Sixty seconds, nine craters, and the whole 106-sticker pack popping up faster and faster. Bonk a pup for +10, a gold pup for +30 — just keep the mallet off the grumpy ones (−15).

▶ Play Whack-a-Pup

🦍 QI Quantum Kong

Classic arcade climbing, Quantum Inu style. Play as Q-Bot and climb the girders and ladders to the golden goal while a random pup up top hurls barrels and glowing quantum orbs down at you — jump the barrels, dodge the orbs, and grab the star.

▶ Play Quantum Kong

🧩 QI Quantum Merge

The 2048-style merge ladder, Quantum Inu style. Slide the board and merge two of the same pup to evolve them into the next tier — chain your merges, climb the ladder, and don't let the board fill up.

▶ Play Quantum Merge

👑 QI Quantum Royale

Battle royale, Quantum Inu style. Drop into a galaxy arena as Q-Bot in the glowing blue circle, grab the color blasters — blue regular, red rapid, green shotgun, yellow rocket — and outlast 23 sticker pups while the storm closes in. Last one standing wins.

▶ Play Quantum Royale

🏍️ QI Quantum Tron

Classic light cycles, Quantum Inu style. You ride Q-Bot in the glowing blue cycle against three rival pups — red, yellow, and green. Trails are walls, the last cycle riding wins the round, and the grid keeps speeding up the longer you survive.

▶ Play Quantum Tron

🔮 QI Quantum Zuma

Marble shooter with the QI sticker pack. Shoot pup balls into the spiral chain and match 3 or more of a color to pop them — when the chain slams shut on another match, combos multiply. Clear the chain to level up; if the front of the chain reaches the pit, it's over.

▶ Play Quantum Zuma

💣 QI Quantum Mines

Minesweeper, Quantum Inu style. 16 grumpy bombs hide in a 9×12 field — the numbers tell you how many grumpies touch each tile. Clear every safe tile for +5 each and the whole field for a +200 bonus. Your first tap is always safe; one wrong tap ends it.

▶ Play Quantum Mines

💎 QI Quantum Crush

Match-3 with the QI sticker pack. Swap pups to line up three or more — every game deals six faces from the full 106 pack, cascades chain for bonus points, and you have 30 moves to run up the score.

▶ Play Quantum Crush

🤖 QI Quantum Runner

The Robot pup runs on his own — you just jump. Tap to jump, tap again mid-air to double jump: clear the crystal spikes and grab blue diamonds for +10 points each. One hit ends the run.

🪽 QI Quantum Flap

One tap, one pup, infinite cosmos. Pick any pup from the full 106-sticker pack and thread the crystal gates — every gate is +1 and the cosmos speeds up with every point.
